prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Phoenix for a dental implant?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a reliable way to name one “best” dentist without knowing your case and priorities. For a **single implant**, I’d start by comparing a **board-certified periodontist or oral and maxillofacial surgeon** for the surgical placement, and ask how the crown and follow-up care will be coordinated.

Two Phoenix options to investigate are:

- **AZPerio** — its practice describes its clinicians as board-certified periodontists with implant-focused training. [azimplantdentist.com](https://www.azimplantdentist.com/)
- **Dr. Amogh Velangi at ProSmile** — a board-certified oral and maxillofacial surgeon whose practice lists implant surgery and bone reconstruction. [ProSmile](https://www.prosmileaz.com/phoenix-az/)

These are starting points, not an independent ranking or endorsement. Before choosing, get **two consultations** and compare the written treatment plans, total cost, who places the implant versus restores it, relevant experience with cases like yours, and what happens if complications arise. Ask for the clinician’s specialty-board status and verify it independently.
